INSERT INTO programme.proposals (call_id, event_id, organization_id, submitted_by, title, slug, summary, objectives, detailed_presentation, format, preferred_start_at, duration_minutes, requested_sessions, scheduling_constraints) SELECT CASE WHEN $10 THEN $1::uuid END, $2, $3, $4, jsonb_build_object('fr', $5::text), $6::text::platform.slug, jsonb_build_object('fr', 'Un résumé.'), '{"fr":"Objectifs du dossier."}'::jsonb, '{"fr":"

Présentation.

"}'::jsonb, 'hybrid', CASE WHEN $7::text IS NOT NULL THEN ($7::text)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE e.timezone END, $8, $9, 'Pas le matin.' FROM event.events e WHERE e.id = $2 RETURNING id
